tasks.description: Validate non-secret LLM and output configuration before generation.
tasks.name: config-check
verifies: CLI configuration resolves without exposing API keys.

tasks.description: Generate a qoder-like run under the isolated eval layout.
tasks.name: generate-qoder-like
verifies: Run manifest records readiness fields and navigation_tree.

tasks.description: Run strict qoder-like verification against a run or release candidate.
tasks.name: verify-qoder-like
verifies: PASS/READY run can proceed to compare and release checks.

tasks.description: Compare generated content against a Qoder baseline and emit readiness evidence.
tasks.name: compare-qoder-baseline
verifies: Comparison status is READY before release publication.

tasks.description: Diagnose canonical versus legacy qoder-like run layouts before publishing.
tasks.name: inspect-eval-layout
verifies: Canonical content root is repowiki/zh/content under each run.

tasks.description: Atomically publish a READY qoder-like run to the stable release path consumed by viewers and the extension.
tasks.name: publish-ready-release
verifies: Release manifest exposes release_status/readiness READY and navigation_tree.

tasks.description: Browse the stable READY release from VS Code/Cursor.
tasks.name: extension-browse-ready-release
verifies: Sidebar reads the fixed release manifest and does not fall back to run directories.
Update Wiki sends the configured repoWikiBrowser.generateCommand in an integrated terminal.
